metadata.name: GeneratedPassword
metadata.description: A password of an exact length drawn from the character sets it names, each with a minimum count, for a database user, an admin account or a service credential. Derived from the host's one secret seed, so it is stable across restarts and never stored; an operator may supply it instead.

password.description: The password: exactly `length` characters of the character sets, each set's `minimum` met.

characters.description: The characters of the set: printable ASCII (U+0021–U+007E), none twice within or across sets.

minimum.description: How many of the password's characters come from this set at least; the minimums sum to at most `length`.

characterSets.description: The sets the password draws from, in order: it holds only their characters and at least each set's `minimum` of it.
